description: This file provides utility functions to read environment variables at runtime in a Create React App (CRA) environment. It exposes functions to retrieve environment configuration and to determine if a backend API base URL is configured.

methods.name: getEnv()
methods.description: Reads and returns selected environment variables related to app configuration, handling empty values and providing defaults.

methods.name: hasBackend()
methods.description: Determines whether a usable backend API base URL is configured.
